label: mid-sequence input of r or g (original positions 3-7)
explanation: Weak, sparse reset-gate unit (about 1% of steps). Fires only in the original phase at positions 3-7 (peak at t=4-5) and on the <DEL> step (about 9% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<=2. Inputs r and g carry about 55% of mass (rate about 7% vs 1% base). Weaker firing on i, 3, 2, k and <DEL>, and mostly on first occurrences of a token. Rate rises when the previous tokens are r/k/g/j and when the sequence starts with 1, but these context conditions trade recall for precision and do not explain it cleanly. The predicate has precision about 0.26: most mid-sequence r/g inputs do not fire, so the unit depends on hidden state that the variables do not capture. Top activations (about 1.0 of max) are r or g at t=4-5 that follow r/k/j/g, often in sequences starting with 1.
